title: ImportAssets2 (tag 71): emit runtime-shared library imports in compiled SWF
description:
The FlashDocument Symbol model (packages/core/src/model/types.ts) carries `importForRuntimeSharing: boolean` and `sharedUrl: string` fields, which Flash 8 uses for runtime shared libraries (RSLs). The SWF spec defines ImportAssets2 (tag 71) to load those assets from a remote SWF. However packages/swf/src/compile.ts emits no ImportAssets2 tag — the fields are ignored during compilation, so RSL symbols silently fail to load at runtime.

The gap is documented in packages/swf/src/__tests__/importassets.test.ts which already contains a tag 71 parser and placeholders marked 'not yet implemented'.

Implement:
1. Add encodeImportAssets2(url: string, symbols: Array<{charId: number; name: string}>): Uint8Array in packages/swf/src/compile.ts or a new importassets.ts, following the tag 71 SWF spec format (tag code 71, reserved UI8=1, URL string, count UI16, [charId UI16 + name string] × n).
2. In compileDocument, collect symbols where importForRuntimeSharing=true and sharedUrl is non-empty. Group by sharedUrl and emit one ImportAssets2 tag per URL in the first frame, immediately after ExportAssets.
3. Activate/fix the existing test assertions in packages/swf/src/__tests__/importassets.test.ts that are currently skipped ('not yet implemented').

Acceptance:
- The importassets.test.ts suite passes with no skipped tests for ImportAssets2 structure.
- A compiled SWF for a document with an RSL symbol contains tag 71 with the correct URL and charId/name mapping (verified by the tag parser in the test file).
